appraisal_events.evidence: je crus faire preuve de pénétration et de force en lui disant quelques paroles ironiques et blessantes destinées à neutraliser le plaisir qu'elle semblait trouver à être photographiée ... je réussis du moins à faire disparaître de son visage cette expression joyeuse qui aurait dû me rendre heureux
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator deliberately extinguishes his grandmother's visible joy at the prospect of being photographed through wounding, ironic remarks; the mature narrating voice explicitly condemns this as a petty cruelty rather than a justified reaction, so her local happiness is diminished by his action.

status_effects.explanation: Her joyful anticipation of the photograph session is deliberately suppressed by her grandson's hurtful remarks, dimming the happy expression on her face within this passage.

The narrator's own retrospective commentary casts his cruelty toward his grandmother as an exasperating, petty flaw rather than an admirable act of penetration or strength, lowering his own standing in the passage's self-judgment.

ambiguities: The passage layers the younger self's in-the-moment self-justification ('je me convainquis que je n'étais pas cruel') against the mature narrator's retrospective condemnation of the same behavior as a 'travers mesquin'; the negative appraisal of the narrator's conduct is attributed to the older narrating voice rather than the acting self.
